verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair axis for a developer platform like Teams, so the story applies. The evidence only documents previewing an uploaded agent or app in Teams, Outlook and the Microsoft 365 app. Nothing shows an isolated sandbox, developer tenant, or separation from production data, so preview is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
